decisions.reason: Saudi country and College of Business and Digital Innovation identify Riyadh campus. Official page lists AI in Business and Analytics degrees, not a distinct department or operations research group; do not substitute US-campus departments.

sources.note: Explicit Riyadh identity, college and programs; distinguishes Connecticut main-campus Pompea College.
Engineering and Advanced Manufacturing college and industrial/systems engineering field remain planning-stage, approval-dependent future offerings.
US-campus Mechanical and Industrial Engineering department found during identity check; not attributed to Riyadh.
US-campus Economics and Business Analytics department and operations/SCM research observed; not attributed to Riyadh.

limitations: No current in-scope Riyadh department verified. General business-management operations coursework is not enough to establish a dedicated unit.
Main-campus US operations departments exist but are deliberately not transferred to this Saudi campus record. Future engineering plans are not current departments.
